      "observations": [
        "All nine eligible owned paths and all 399 selected diff lines were read. The 23 imported third_party/rust/async-lock paths remain metadata-only exclusions: their bodies were never read or copied. The Cargo manifest/lock additions establish the dependency identity only; no imported Mutex implementation or performance guarantee is inferred.",
        "The original native incoming server stores mClient and initializes it with this; the Rust sender holds a server RefPtr. The patch replaces that sender field with Mutex<RefCell<Option<RefPtr<ServerT>>>>. Its async shutdown replaces the option with None, and server() clones an available reference or returns ClientClosed. The owned error mapping returns NS_BASE_STREAM_CLOSED for that error. This breaks the sender's retained reference when shutdown executes, but does not prove that every other reference or observer has disappeared.",
        "The IDL bridge and outgoing-server-removal observer detach shutdown futures, then return. The matching observer also attempts to remove itself from message-smtpserver-removed. There is no wait for queued operations or in-flight network completion in either entry point. The incoming C++ caller forwards Shutdown and GetRunning rather than adding a completion wait.",
        "Original queue stop closes the channel, clears its stored runner references and then awaits sender shutdown. Spawned Runner::run tasks own their Arc and await each op.perform. Original running counts the stored list, so it can return false after that list is cleared while an operation still awaits completion. Original idle compares the idle count to that same now-empty list, so its empty-list result is true. These bounded static paths conflict with the IDL's fully-stopped/running and running-false/idle-false wording. They are not a reproduced leak, panic, request-after-shutdown or hang.",
        "The initial server() check and later credential/error/reporting access reject once they observe None. In original send_http_request, obtaining credentials precedes awaiting to_auth_header_value and sending the request, so an earlier successful check is not cancellation of work already in progress. The short server() method clones the RefPtr while accessing the field; it does not keep the lock guard across the later credential future.",
        "Accepted source moves the sender and observer to protocol_shared. The sender uses Mutex<Option<RefPtr>>, takes the reference at shutdown, and separately removes observer registrations/auth cache entries. The EWS ProtocolClient implementation first awaits an external operation-queue stop and then awaits shared sender shutdown. Exact current bridge, caller, field, error mapping and helper windows are retained, but operation-queue 1.2.0 internals are an unread dependency; the historical empty-list conclusion is not projected onto its current completion behavior.",
        "No tests or assertions change in the owned patch. The field/shutdown comments explain the reference-cycle and absence signal, but the original server() summary is the unfinished 'Get a'; accepted source adds an explicit ClientClosed contract. The original running/idle comments still call stop synchronous although stop is now async; its RefCell clear itself occurs before the await. No imported crate contract, native execution, concurrency test, memory measurement or zero-network result is claimed.",
        "Primary Bug 2022247 is complete through current comments 0–2, activity and end controls, originally read by Parent. The author reports an outgoing-server/client/sender reference cycle, tentatively includes incoming servers, and explains the Mutex/absent-RefPtr design. The linked Matrix discussion is unread; the report is not a fresh leak, allocator or shutdown-race measurement. Only the nine owned integration/dependency paths were studied; the 23 imported crate bodies remain excluded.",
        "D286920 is complete from creation to landing, including actual old inline 1564346 and no summary edits. The sole nit changes runner to runners in the running() comment; the landed comment does use the plural, checked in the exact historical queue source. Acceptance and Done are separate from code semantics. The author says some Try failures seem unrelated, which is retained as a qualified historical judgment, not a diagnosed cause.",
        "Actual source reconciles detached shutdown return, later server-reference removal, and the original runner-list state. The empty-list running/idle conclusions are scoped to this historical in-tree queue. The accepted EWS caller instead delegates queue stop to operation-queue 1.2.0 before shared sender shutdown; that imported crate's internals remain unread. No claim of proven leak removal, zero further traffic or native concurrency correctness is made. Child D287417 is a bounded later-family locator."
